We need apply rule. Input 6 rows x 9 cols. Nonzeros: 3 at row2 col0; 6 at row2 col4. Only one obstacle. Start (2,0) dir R. Nearest obstacle in row2 to right: 6 at (2,4). Fill c0..c3 with 3, obstacle c4=6. P=(2,3). Color 6 -> right turn from R = D (down). Current=(2,3). No more obstacles in D (rows3-5 col3 zero). Fill down to bottom rows3,4,5 col3=3. Output: zeros except row2 c0,c1,c2,c3=3,c4=6; col3 rows3-5=3. Need check if vertical starts at P row2 c3 already filled. So rows3,4,5 c3=3.

Let's construct 6x9:
r0 all 0
r1 all 0
r2: c0=3,c1=3,c2=3,c3=3,c4=6,c5-8=0 => [3,3,3,3,6,0,0,0,0]
r3: c3=3 => [0,0,0,3,0,0,0,0,0]
r4 same
r5 same.

Submit.
